summary: This trace reveals a new task type (harbor_vaxcrate_6v12) that follows the same abstract pattern as infusion-batch-analysis and reagent-kit-analysis, but with distinct entity names and filtering rules. The agent succeeded by creating a custom script, but this capability should be generalized into a reusable skill. The key insight is that this is a 'dispatch cycle analysis' with: (1) JSON catalog with alias matching, (2) CSV overrides with revision/status filtering, (3) CSV billing with active/latest selection, (4) CSV supply costs, (5) per-entity counts (clinics/sites), and (6) days-per-dispatch frequency comparison. The skill should capture the common workflow while documenting variant-specific field mappings.
